title: docs(pm-dispatch): a card thread's needs_decision fork goes to a coordinator-opened ruling thread under the director's delegated channel

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHWDjSD5SM4wDKfh36BCP2T)_

Fixes #25216

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The maintainer's standing word of 2026-10-22 is written into the pm-dispatch skill once, in the director charter, and the `mode:thread` runbook names its mechanics in one line. Verbatim, untranslated:

> 对于这种类似的问题，能否你自己开一个单独的 fable thread 做评审，对于自己有把握决定的问题，自己决定，不能决定的开决策卡？

First use: ruling record `6336640643` (letter A, confirmed by the maintainer in that thread at 08:53Z). The word itself is not re-decided here; this PR decides only where and how it is written.

**`references/lanes/director.md`** (〈授权与形态〉, four lines added, one edited in place):

- `项目内代裁通道:卡线程报 needs_decision ⇒ coordinator 开裁决线程代本席裁,⛔ 非子代理。` — inside a Claude Code project the ruling thread is the director seat's delegated channel: it rules on the seat's behalf, it is a session the coordinator opens, not a subagent of any seat.
- a blockquote carrying the word above, with the first-use ruling record as provenance.
- `「有把握」= ../triage-duties.md 置信门四条全立,⛔ 不宽于它;余者一张决策卡呈维护者。` — "confident" is exactly the 置信门 (four prongs: 四棱同向, 不在人工地板, 不推翻既有维护者裁决, 执行是否决窗口), nothing wider; everything else goes to the maintainer as one decision card.
- `录裁同上形:批次位写 needs_decision fork,maintainer 位引常设令;逐裁一行进 coordinator 追认表。` — the record is the charter's own `Ruling:` first line (the batch slot names the fork, the maintainer slot quotes the standing word, as the first-use ruling did), posted on the card; every ruling is one row of the 追认表 the coordinator keeps, which the maintainer overturns with one letter (triage-duties: 「被推翻的行按新裁决执行」).
- edited: `未回字 = 不在 = 停,⛔ 无巡检、审计、快照、聊天、卡评论;唯一例外是项目内代裁通道。` — the summoned seat still stops without the maintainer's letter; the project-mode channel is the one carve-out, which is the point of the word (the maintainer is away for hours).

**`references/dispatch-runbook.md`** (〈卡线程(`mode:thread`)〉, one line added): `终报 needs_decision ⇒ 席位交 coordinator 开 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 裁决线程(lanes/director.md)。` — the mechanics: the seat hands the fork to the coordinator, who opens the ruling thread at the contract-review tier; the ruling rules live in the charter.

**`SKILL.md`**: untouched. Measured: no SKILL.md line contradicts the rule once the channel is the director seat's own (see the three reconciliations below), and the file sits at headroom 0.

## The three reconciliations the card requires

| Text read (on `origin/main` f2ade4a) | What this PR writes, and why they agree |
|:--|:--|
| SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 ruler line: 「总监席是唯一裁决者:决策箱、代裁与一类自裁只出自本席,⛔ 无子代理无自述。」 | director.md 「项目内代裁通道:…coordinator 开裁决线程**代本席裁**,⛔ 非子代理」. The ruling still comes from the director seat, through its channel; the thread is a coordinator-opened session, not a subagent of a seat (SKILL.md's `batch:` row counts dev threads as 子代理 because a seat spawns them; this one no seat spawns, and it holds no card). The record lands on the card in the charter's `Ruling:` form, so nothing is 自述. No second ruler, no exception added to the ruler line. |
| 红线: 「⛔ 永不代维护者答产品或架构问题;唯一例外是已裁的代裁通道,不得宽于其置信门。」 | The channel is a 代裁通道 the maintainer ruled into existence by the word quoted above, so it is 「已裁」; director.md 「「有把握」= `../triage-duties.md` 置信门四条全立,⛔ 不宽于它」 makes its gate exactly the 置信门 — the contract review's objection to the earlier text (「有把握」 read as a wider gate than the channel's) is answered by definition, not by a second exception. `triage-duties.md` is cited, not redefined. |
| director charter: L7 授权面 = 人工定期召唤; L16 「未回字 = 不在 = 停:维护者不在则本席不运行…」; L9 「裁决只存在于本卡」; L11 the `Ruling:` first-line form; L13/L40 the 摘要台账. | L16 gains 「唯一例外是项目内代裁通道」 (the one line that would otherwise contradict a thread ruling while the maintainer is away). The new lines bind the channel to L9 (record on the card), L11 (「录裁同上形」, with the two slots spelled for a fork) and to the 追认表 (one row per ruling, overturnable). The seat's other two duties (audit, maintainer-action ledger) are not delegated: the channel rules one fork. |

`git grep -n "唯一裁决者\|置信门\|代裁通道"` over the skill at the head: ten lines (SKILL.md 30, 106, 264, 267, 276; director.md 16, 21, 23; triage-duties.md 5, 103); no two disagree — every use of 代裁通道 is a channel under the 置信门, and the ruler line stays the only statement of who rules.

One line edited in place (116 → 119 B). |

Longest added bullet: 120 bytes (the record line, at the cap). The blockquote is 239 bytes and structurally exempt (a blockquote line is a verbatim maintainer ruling, per the ratchet's own exemption set). Headroom after this PR: 0 on all three files; the next edit to any of them pays by compression.

## Judgment calls, for the contract review

1. **Home = the charter, not SKILL.md.** The card allows either 「the ruling thread acts as the director's delegated channel」 or 「the line names this exception」; the first keeps the ruler line byte-identical and needs no SKILL.md line (headroom 0). If the review wants the exception named in SKILL.md too, one line must be bought there by compression.
2. **The word is quoted in full, in a blockquote.** It contains a model word; AGENTS.md exempts a verbatim maintainer ruling preserved as a quotation block, and the ratchet exempts blockquote lines from the byte cap. The operative rules spell the tier as `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
3. **The gate is the 置信门 only.** The charter's 一类自裁门 (triage-duties 107–113) is the summoned seat's; the order fixes the 置信门 as the measure of 「有把握」 and the 红线 says 「不得宽于其置信门」, so the channel is not given the second door. A later word can widen it.
4. **The ledger is named by its keeper, not its path.** 「进 coordinator 追认表」 says who keeps the list the maintainer overturns from; the coordinator reference that spells the file is a serial card after this one and is not written here.

## Acceptance notes

- The first-use ruling (`6336640643`) spelled its first line as `Ruling: needs_decision fork review (project review thread 「…」) · letter A · maintainer 「…」`; the form fixed here (`needs_decision fork` in the batch slot) is the compressed version of that. History is not rewritten. noted, not filed.
- SKILL.md's director line 「未回字 = 不在 = 停」 (〈升级与决策〉) keeps describing the summoned seat; the project-mode carve-out lives in the charter only, which SKILL.md points to from the `director` argument row. noted, not filed.
- The harness writes an HTML comment as line 1 of this PR body (the project attribution marker the session context requires); os-dev.md 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Reported as a deviation, as the previous card thread did; the skills seat has the card for the exemption. carrier: the skills seat.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:把您 10-22 的那句话写进 pm-dispatch 技能的总监章程:项目里卡线程报 `needs_decision` 时,coordinator 开一个契约复核档的裁决线程,代总监席裁;「有把握」就是分诊置信门四条全立,不宽于它;其余攒成一张决策卡给您;每条裁决按章程的 `Ruling:` 格式落卡,并进 coordinator 的追认表,您一个字就能翻。runbook 的卡线程节加一行写机制。

**为什么改**:这条规则之前只在 PR 正文里引过您的话,与技能里「总监席是唯一裁决者」和红线「代裁通道不得宽于置信门」相抵,被契约复核退回、拆成本卡。现在写成总监席自己的项目内代裁通道,置信门就是它的门,三处文本不再打架。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改技能文本,不动代码与门禁。行数棘轮:director.md 用掉 3 行余量并删掉 1 句与 SKILL.md 四轴框架重复的话,runbook 用掉最后 1 行余量;这两个文件与 SKILL.md 现在都顶着上限,下次改动须先压缩。回滚 = revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**:(席位填写)

**你要做的**:无须您动手。`.claude/**` 是 Tier S:技能席做达档契约复核 PASS 后入队落地。只有一件可选:若您希望裁决线程也能走章程里的「一类自裁门」(不只是置信门),回一个字,席位补一行。
